why: the owner's scoreboard relay carried scores, not venues, and the tier-discipline gate refuses a canonical final with a blank venue because a blank venue silently makes the park factor 1.0.
method: each home team's venue was taken from that team's most recent tier-1 row already in results.csv dated before 2026-08-23. Nothing is invented: every value already existed in the canonical table under the same home team.
not_applied_to: ATL@MIL, which carries its neutral-site venue from the acquisition record and was set at ingest
limitation: a venue carried forward is an INFERENCE that the home team played at its usual park. It is correct for a normal home game and wrong for any relocated or neutral-site game not already flagged. ATL@MIL was flagged; nothing else on this slate was.
